hooks.text: 四槽战阵把卡组构筑与武将调度绑定，每名武将拥有独特天赋并可形成大量组合。
hooks.excerpt: Four slots on the battlefield are yours to command — deploy and withdraw any general as the moment demands. Each general carries unique talents, with thousands of possible combinations.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每局可从不同州开局，在8州49城的事件、商店、招募、休整等节点中选择进军洛阳的路线。
hooks.excerpt: 8 Provinces, 49 Cities — A Campaign That Never Repeats The "Nine Provinces" lie scattered like mist, their heroes blazing like stars — each run, choose any province as your starting ground. Conquer six cities within your province, and the road to Sili opens — all the way to Luoyang. Events, shops, recruitment, rest stops, drills, inheritance — the choices among them shape the path of your fate.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 包括Boss在内的敌将都可用劝降令策反，持续招募还会点亮星图新天赋。
hooks.excerpt: Every enemy general can be persuaded — even bosses. Use Persuasion Decrees of varying quality to attempt the turn, and with luck, the enemy will change banners and stand with you. — As recruitment count rises, you unlock the Star Chart and light new talents.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
